trial_court: VI Additional Principal Judge, Family Court, Bangalore, MC No.3356/2013 and MC No.3812/2013
case_name: Gayathri Bai B N vs Dashrath Singh R
facts_of_case: The parties are Gayathri Bai B N and Dashrath Singh R. The respondent-husband filed a petition for divorce under the Hindu Marriage Act, while the appellant-wife sought a decree for restitution of conjugal rights. The trial court allowed the husband's petition and dismissed the wife's petition. This appeal is against that judgment.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the party seeking restitution of conjugal rights to prove that the other party has deserted him/her without reasonable cause.
legal_principles.held: So far as petition in M.C. No.3812/2013 which is filed by the respondent-wife under Section 9 of the Hindu Marriage Act, for restitution of conjugal rights is concerned, similar contentions were raised by the respondent-wife.

legal_principles.principle: A party seeking divorce must prove that the other party has deserted him/her without reasonable cause.
legal_principles.held: Therefore she contended that the allegations made against her are false and prayed to dismiss the petition.

outcome.final_order: The appeals are allowed, and the judgment and decree passed by the trial court are set aside.
